horoscope: Work efforts or duties could be on the chaotic or disorganized side today, dear Aries. You are being encouraged to think creatively rather than rigidly regarding work and health now, which can feel a little transitional, but do your best to prioritize. You're likely to have the most successful day if you consciously detach yourself a little from some of the pressures you've been feeling in order to regroup emotionally. However, something might be said that's taken the wrong way today, or there can be some vague worries about performance. Simply be as clear as possible when communicating, and do your best without expecting perfection from yourself. The Moon heads into your communications sector, igniting your curiosity. New ideas and approaches to your social life can emerge and empower you.

It's important today that you give loved ones some room to breathe, dear Taurus. There is some tendency to extremes in thinking right now, and you may discover that it's important to find some kind of balance. Something doesn't quite measure up as you had hoped, particularly when it comes to material goods or comfort items. Today's Moon does create an atmosphere for you in which you more readily get down to business, however. While it's a good day for practical thinking overall, take extra care with communications, as they may be interpreted differently than you intended. This may be particularly important for written communications, as their general tone can be interpreted in many different ways. Tensions should ease as you feel less pressured to produce.

The Moon entering your sign today helps to turn the focus back to your needs, dear Gemini. You've been giving a lot of yourself, and that has been rewarding in many ways, but now you need some important "me time". You're more visible than you have been in recent days. There may be some irritability or misunderstandings, especially in domestic or love relationships, and you could feel a little drained after having given so much of yourself in an effort to make things right. Lift your thinking to a broader perspective if you find yourself surrounded by negative talk, bickering, or emotional blackmail. Avoid getting caught up in it. Address issues presented to you if need be, but keep explanations short and to the point if others are treating you with suspicion.

New understanding of information can challenge your previous beliefs today, dear Cancer, or you could be privy to information that worries or disagrees with you. Watch for manipulative tactics, but also be aware that today is not very strong for direct approaches either. If possible, it's best to wait to address an important issue until later, when people are more receptive, and your own thinking is more positive. Find ways to balance your environment so that you can avoid unnecessary stress today, as you are more sensitive to things going wrong. It's minor and temporary, but there can be moments when you feel as if you are walking on eggshells around certain people. You probably are! Keep things light and positive. This is a strong day, however, for research, investigation, and any task that involves throwing yourself into it with vigor.

With today's minor Mercury-Pluto challenge, dear Leo, watch that you don't convey the message that your skin is thick, as you could wind up with hurt feelings. At the same time, avoid taking words spoken to heart, as what is said today is unlikely to reflect others' intentions or true feelings. Rather, it may be people's fears taking the driver's seat. Sudden awareness of a pre-existing situation, or totally new information, can figure strongly today, especially regarding a significant person in your life. Something personal might be revealed today. Changing attitudes towards others' opinions of you these days can lead you to want to do something out of the ordinary to drive home the point that you don't care. But the truth may be that you do care, for now, and you have more "work" to do before arriving at a point where you are as free-spirited as you'd like to be. Worries today may center around relationships, but also finances. Fortunately, the day is strong for identifying problem areas, and you may be pulling off difficult tasks with ease.

There's a tendency to be provocative in communications today, dear Virgo, as the desire may be to shake things up a little, possibly without even being aware of it! You can be quite bored with traditional or intolerant thinking and stances, and you may want to argue a point in an attempt to open others' minds. Consider that you may very well be most successful if you are subtle - something that can be difficult to pull off today with current transits. Dealing with doubt in others may figure strongly today as well. You may be reading too much into a situation. There could be more to a financial transaction than meets the eye, or a "catch" to deal with. You are more goal-oriented today and tomorrow, and you might catch a wave of inspiration. Changing attitudes towards others' expectations or opinions can lead you to want to do something out of the ordinary. Ideas for progress can be original.

You may need to put your personal issues aside to take care of business today, dear Libra, at least until you feel that you have everything under control. However, the problem may actually be control and needing too much of it. Distractions seem abundant now, but if you attempt to take care of one thing at a time, you'll be better off for it. You are more aware of taboos and blocks these days, and more inclined to want to break through them. Equally strong, however, is the urge for more privacy, so you may end up doing nothing that you've planned, and feeling a little restless. Fortunately, once past this tendency, certain subjects and pursuits can really light a fire under you, and there can be a lot of exciting things to learn.

You might feel pushed into a corner on a mental level today, dear Scorpio, but without the answers, especially if others are goading. Even though there is slightly discouraging or demotivating energy today, you can be very involved in your own individual direction and derive quite a bit of enjoyment or focus from it. Others are recognizing your vision and intelligence these days, and you're more inclined to express your ideas and use your skills with confidence. The Moon heads into your solar eighth house, and you're inclined to go within for some healing introspection. It's best not to rush a financial or intimate matter.

You can experience a very strong desire to expose a truth or to get to the bottom of something today, dear Sagittarius. You are typically very good at finding answers, but you should probably be careful not to push too hard right now. Keep in mind that one can't "unsee" certain things once they've come into their vision. Today's communications can be tricky, especially in business or with those in authority. Finding the right words can be difficult when it seems that others are seeking out the negative. Words can get twisted around. Tread lightly, but stand your ground if necessary. Do what is reasonable to release stress in your own body and in the environment around you, even if it means a little solitude to restore harmony and balance. A one-track mind today can be useful if you're focusing on facts and figures, but difficult if you're dealing with a social matter.

You can be filled with ideas right now, dear Capricorn, but you're inclined to let them mature before sharing, as you might be subject to criticism, which can weaken your motivation. Consider reorganizing your finances now, as you can form solid strategies. Watch today for misunderstandings around education, learning, communication, and transportation. The Moon heads into your solar sixth house of work and health, and small problems or flaws bother you enough to motivate you to handle them. You're prepared to fix things. However, if your energy isn't at its strongest, focus on building your strength and stamina.

Communications are emphasized today, dear Aquarius, and doing something constructive as a team can figure strongly. There can be a strong desire to get to the bottom of something today, whether it's about exposing a truth or a lie. Your words and communications have more impact than they usually do - people truly listen to you and "hear" you right now. You could be heavily invested in your ideas right now. In a search for truths, you can sometimes put yourself in a poor situation with Pluto in your sign and a tendency to see the darker side of situations. Watch today for this tendency. Opportunities today tend to lie in research and analysis. Avoid psychoanalyzing those close to you, though, as there can be touchiness now. Patience might be hard to muster up today, but the rewards can be great later on.

You can have some trouble harmonizing your feelings and attitudes with others at times today, dear Pisces. You may experience difficulties in certain social or personal situations due to a bit of awkwardness, and you might unwittingly stir up conflicts. There can be compelling conversations or thoughts about a partnership or special someone. The Moon heads into your sector of home and personal life, and you begin to seek some comfort and time and space for centering yourself. Today's energies do take you on a bit of a ride regardless, as there can be frustration or suspicion, and thoughts or communications can feel extreme or exaggerated until you gain some perspective.
